title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #153 · 팔레트 통일 [틸·코랄 핑크·크림] · 대각 띠·매끈 · 4영역(몬드리안+칸딘스키+무하+이레즈미) · 풀커버 · powerlifter bombshell · 손허리·턱 · Korean · 배경 계단식 논 · 인스타글램
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 20s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, voluminous curls natural black hair — her body is painted in 4 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Every style is rendered in one shared palette of teal, coral pink and cream, so the whole figure reads as one harmonious composition. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 28% of the way down her figure from the top, about 43% of the way down her figure from the top and about 68% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick lines and flat blocks rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Kandinsky style circles, triangles and sweeping lines rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Mucha style Art Nouveau flowing floral curves rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo art with peonies, waves and clouds rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg, her legs fully in view — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy deep emerald leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, in deep emerald lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: green stepped rice terraces with a stone path, a waist-high stone wall and a standard-height farm hut door at her side, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
